newsitem.title: USA: Centerior unit to restart Lake Shore plant.
newsitem.headline: Centerior unit to restart Lake Shore plant.

text.p: Cleveland Electric Illuminating Co said Tuesday it will restart its idled Lake Shore plant this week to help meet summer demand for electricity and for wholesale power sales to other utilities.
The company, a unit of Centerior Energy, said the plant had been slated for retirement, but re-engineering efforts had allowed it to resume operations there.

It said 27 employees will work at the plant. It said the plant will burn western coal, which will lower its nitrogen oxide emissions by at least 10 percent and its sulfur dioxide emission rate by about one-third compared with last year.
